description:
Details of `409 conflict` `box_users_present` on the switch to `governance: app`:
box users (`k2:owner`, `k2:connect:`) are never members of an App-governed Space. K2
removes them first; a box-user owner is the one Sew removes itself (the App's service owner
takes over).

external_ids.description: The box users in the Space other than the owner, ascending.

items.description: An external identity: k2:principal:<uuid>, k2:workspace:<uuid>, k2:connect:<uuid>, k2:owner, k2:server (K2's server service owner), local:<handle>, link:<channel_id>:<base32> (a meeting link guest), app:<app_id> (an App's service owner) or erased:<member_id> (an erased member's tombstone id; never accepted as input).

title: MgmtBoxUsersDetails
